content: Square POS UI supports split-tender payments (multiple payment methods against one sale) via 'Split Amount', looping additional payment entries until the balance is zero. Square's server-side APIs are more limited: Terminal API does not support splitting a single checkout into multiple payments in one request; multi-payment/split-tender against an Order requires creating an Order, then calling PayOrder repeatedly with partial amounts and finally including all resulting payment IDs to complete/close the order once the balance reaches zero. The durable model is Order (source of truth for total/balance) with N child Payment records, each independently authorized/captured, reconciled against the order.
